Be Still Moments

You’re already welcome here—one still minute counts; you don’t have to finish every line.

Five short pauses to remember the Lord is near

Monday — Psalm 46:10

“Be still, and know that I am God…”

What one word or picture comes to mind when you read this?

Even one minute is enough. The Lord is near.

Tuesday — Psalm 5:3

“In the morning, O Lord, Thou wilt hear my voice…”

What would you like to bring to the Lord this morning?

The Lord hears you.

Wednesday — Psalm 118:24

“This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”

What is one small thing you can rejoice in today?

This day is a gift.

Thursday — Lamentations 3:22-23

“It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed… They are new every morning.”

What mercy have you seen this week?

His mercies are new every morning.

Friday — Psalm 143:8

“Cause me to hear Thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in Thee do I trust…”

What do you need to trust the Lord with today?

He is trustworthy.

These moments are not another task — they are an invitation to rest in the One who holds you.
